comment: Highlights the NMBL body of a `nmbl`…`` tagged template literal inside JS/TS/JSX code samples (the JSX target — React / Solid / Qwik). Registered via `injectTo` against the JS-family root scopes in astro.config. The surrounding JavaScript stays JS-highlighted; only the template body switches to `source.nmbl`. Unlike the `<template lang="nmbl">` injection, a single multi-scope selector is fine here because the JS grammars have no special tagged-template handling to clash with. `${…}` interpolation holes render as plain text, which is acceptable for a code sample.
